# sharness.ai — SHarness

> SHarness runs agents and their tools as small, single-purpose processes, each locked down by
> the kernel and talking only over allowed, mutually authenticated connections, so a secret
> lives in one place and a tricked process can only do its one job.

Site version: v0.2.0. Status of the project: DESIGN. Nothing described on this site is built.
By Dinis Cruz; design session written up with Claude, 24 October 2026. All content CC BY 4.0.
SHarness is unrelated to Sharness, the shell testing library.

## Properties agents may rely on

- Every claim is labelled. MEASURED means probed or timed in one Claude agent workspace on
  24 Oct 2026, with method on /evidence/. Everything else is DESIGNED or PROPOSED. "Not yet
  measured" items are listed on /evidence/. The site never claims anything is built, never
  claims protection against root or kernel compromise, and says nothing about any platform's
  plans.
- Every design page is available as markdown at the same path: /<page>/index.md. The markdown
  is the SOURCE; the HTML is generated from it (admin/build/gen_pages.py) and CI fails if they
  drift.
- The source design pack is published verbatim under /briefs/sharness-brief-pack/ (the brief
  for this site plus docs 00–07). Docs 01–04 use sgit-specific names: sgit-kms →
  sharness.kms, sgit-net → sharness.net, sgit-fs → sharness.fs, sgit-cli → the harnessed app.
- /llms-full.txt is this file plus every page's markdown in one fetch, GENERATED.
- The version in /admin/build/version.txt agrees with every page badge, this file,
  /llms-full.txt and /index.md: the pre-release gate fails the release otherwise.

## The design (read in this order)

- /why/index.md — the last metre: a sealed vault key exposed on arrival (disk, argv, the
  transcript); goals; threat model (kernel trusted; root out of scope)
- /architecture/index.md — the components and the edge matrix (deny by default; the app never
  talks to the KMS); mutual TLS 1.3 with a session CA whose key is destroyed after issuing;
  measured costs (~3.2 ms per handshake); deployment topologies A–E
- /components/index.md — sharness.launcher, .kms, .net, .fs, .bash, .llm, .policy: one job,
  one uid, one policy, one certificate each; transparent vs harness-aware apps; size targets
- /keys/index.md — the sealed handover; the KMS protocol (init, public, unwrap, seal_to,
  destroy); sealing to one-time keys; binding a remote caller; where the private key lives
  (default: frozen process + memfd_secret)
- /policies/index.md — Process Behaviour Policies: ABP (mandate, grant, delta, barrier)
  applied to processes; intersection-composed layers; the one hash the person supplies; the
  enforcement map; learning a policy from strace; prompt-injection walkthrough
- /agents/index.md — how an agent message flowed in the observed workspace; where SHarness
  plugs in; sharness.llm (Messages API compatible, secret filter on tool results);
  sharness.bash; the dual-LLM split
- /process-tree/index.md — making every process go through sharness.bash; side doors;
  safety rules for testing in a live session. PROOF OF CONCEPT NOT YET RUN

## Status and project

- /evidence/index.md — every measurement with method, date and caveats; what is not measured
- /roadmap/index.md — decided, open decisions, refactor path in sgit, end state (a proposal),
  and ground rules for the agents that will build SHarness
- /about/index.md — identity and naming rules: brand SHarness; command `sharness-ai` (never
  plain `sharness`); env prefix SHARNESS_AI_ (proposed); components sharness.<role>
- /documents/index.md — the source documents, verbatim, with known issues
- /shipped/index.html — what exists as code today (a placeholder package) vs the design
- /cli/index.html — the sharness-ai package on PyPI and its release pipeline
- /admin/comms.html — open requests (R3: the design pages need review before briefing builders)
